title: Update AGENTS.md, README, and docs for the two-repo shape

comments.author: home
comments.text:
AGENTS.md currently states the rule this epic reverses: "web/ — Next.js app:
marketing at / and product workspace at /chat ... One web project, not a
separate marketing repo." Update that section to describe the two-repo shape:
this repo owns the product and doubles as the shared package; Chattic.us-web
is private and owns marketing plus (eventually, per the follow-on waitlist
epic) billing.

Update README's environment table and docs/STACK.md wherever they describe
chattic.us as served from this repo's web/. Leave docs/BRAND_GUIDELINES.md in
place but note it now governs both repos.

comments.author: home
comments.text: AGENTS.md updated in PR #300 (b6e8277): removed the 'Marketing news desk'/'Marketing wiki' sections (those AGENTS.md files no longer exist here), replaced the 'one web project, not a separate marketing repo' claim with the actual two-repo boundary and a pointer to the shared-package exports map, and fixed the product-name/marketing-site framing at the top. README.md fixed directly on develop (1fc7a97): chattic.us's role now correctly attributes it to the private Chattic.us-web repo in both the deploy-status and public-sites tables. Broader README staleness unrelated to this split (production/staging CloudFront described as disabled when it's actually enabled) flagged as a separate follow-up task, not fixed here -- out of scope for this epic.
